story: Show HN: Sapper.js – towards a better web app framework
text: "This framework is 95% ideal, let's build another framework for my personal 5%." This attitude is why we have a hundred different relevant frameworks right now. How about instead of a building a new framework, you contribute to an existing one? You even say that Next is close to what you want... why not help to make it better? Relevant song about this issue: [VIDEO]
If you're aiming for the eternal, a message board full of computer geeks may not be the best place to find it. Lagniappe: [VIDEO]
